title: hieracium angustatum subsp. microcymon
intro: Hieracium angustatum subsp. microcymon, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against free radical damage. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium angustatum subsp. microcymon are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
